knowledge_gaps: Perturbations are applied before truncation. For histories longer than the model context, removing old interactions may leave the input unchanged, while removing recent interactions introduces previously invisible older items. Construct all variants from the same visible history window and report actual changed positions.

Removing recent versus older interactions also changes positional assignments and potentially temporal biases. The report needs explicit timestamp handling, position handling, and controls separating item removal from these effects.

Training-prefix targets can reflect memorization and cannot establish generalization or current user intent. The diagnostic needs a clearly limited interpretation and a separate, fixed validation confirmation protocol.

Reproduction requires exact user limits, context length, suffix length, bootstrap count, confidence level, sampling procedure, overlap formula, and handling of unavailable categories. Macro results should not silently average fewer than four categories.

The ModelView contract demonstrates per-position candidate scoring, but does not establish that the proposed final-feature scoring shapes or timestamp interventions are supported. These interfaces require verification before implementation.

Potential 8/10 is optimistic for an unvalidated diagnostic; difficulty 3/10 omits interface and perturbation controls. Existing empty-sample and misleading embedding-collapse outputs also need correction before their metrics are merged.
